name: RankSEO AI keyword research
description: Verify the authenticated AI Keyword Research experience from its landing state through validated search controls, realtime report progress, and the completed evidence-based keyword report.

planSteps.description: Start with a clean signed-out browser session, navigate to /auth/sign-up, and create a new account using a unique email address, a valid name, and the password "RankSEO-Test-2026!".
Verify account creation succeeds and the browser is redirected to the protected /ai-keyword page.
Verify the initial AI Keyword Research screen shows an "Enter a keyword" input, Language and Location selectors, an "AI Search" button, and the heading "AI-powered keyword research".
Verify Language defaults to English, Location defaults to United States with its flag, and the AI Search button is disabled while the keyword input is empty.
Verify the landing state includes the four benefit cards "Research AI prompts and responses", "Find secret SEO gems", "Optimize for search intent", and "Master local search".
Enter the one-character keyword "a" without submitting.
Verify the AI Search button remains disabled because the keyword must contain at least two trimmed characters, and verify no progress or report view appears.
Replace the keyword with "content marketing for small businesses", change Language to Spanish, and change Location to Canada.
Verify the selected language reads Spanish, the selected location reads Canada with its flag, and the AI Search button becomes enabled.
Click the AI Search button once.
Verify duplicate submission is prevented while the request is active: the search action is disabled and displays "Researching…".
Verify the landing benefit cards are replaced by a live card headed "Generating your report" with the message that RankSEO will keep processing if the user leaves the page.

Verify the live report exposes a progress bar between 0 and 100 percent and shows the five stages: Preparing keyword search, Collecting research sources, Reviewing cited sources, Analysing research findings, and Building keyword report.
Wait for the keyword research run to reach a terminal state without refreshing or resubmitting the form.

Verify the successful terminal state replaces the live progress card with an AI keyword report headed "content marketing for small businesses" and displays "Overall SEO Score" with a numeric score from 0 through 100.
Verify Report overview displays non-negative values for Sources analysed, Unique domains, Competitors found, and Prompt opportunities.
Verify the completed report includes Top sources, AI summary, Source mix, Competitors and peers, Content opportunity, AI prompt opportunities, and Related keyword ideas sections.
Verify the competitor table uses the user-facing columns Mentions, Share, and Strength. If any competitor has zero mentions, verify it shows 0% share and "Not mentioned" strength.
Verify the related keyword table uses the columns Keyword, Topic group, Why it matters, and Relevance, and that displayed relevance values are percentages.
Verify the report includes the disclaimer that the result is a directional content score rather than a Google ranking or search-volume metric.
Resize the browser viewport to a mobile width of approximately 390 pixels while remaining on the completed report.
Verify the keyword search controls and completed report remain readable without horizontal page overflow, and report cards stack into a single-column mobile layout.
